title: Lantern

[[Image:Lantern.png|right|160px]]
'''Lantern''' is a [[common item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] game, but a corrected copy was included in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Bonus''': +1 to [[luck check|Luck checks]].

'''Price''': $3

===Correction===
The original card featured more complicated text ("'''Any Phase:''' Exhaust to re-roll 1 die after making a '''Luck check'''.") and specified a lower cost ($2).
